Metadata.title: FoodSource
Metadata.description: Find and compare food suppliers for restaurants, manufacturers, and procurement teams.

Footer.note: Demonstration workspace. Supplier records are not loaded yet, and nothing here is a confirmed commercial offer.

Landing.title: Find food suppliers and compare their terms
Landing.subtitle: FoodSource is a place to look up suppliers by product, category, and city, then keep a shortlist. The catalog is still empty. The interface is available in Russian and English.
Landing.searchText: Look up a supplier, product, or category. The query stays in the page address.
Landing.compareText: Place up to three suppliers side by side once the catalog is loaded.
Landing.saveText: Keep a shortlist with notes and a contact status for the demo workspace.
Landing.categoriesText: Choose a category to open the catalog with that name in the search.

Shell.demoBanner: Demonstration data. Information on this platform is not confirmed commercial fact.
